exam.title: Exam-target batches, timed to your exam
exam.lead: From Class 10 onwards we open short, high-intensity batches during exam season — including SAY & Improvement exam classes for Plus One and Plus Two, with exam assistance right up to the hall. Weekdays 2 PM – 7 PM, weekends 7 AM – 6:30 PM.

faqs.q: What classes and boards do you teach?
faqs.a: We tutor LKG to Class 12 (Plus Two) across Kerala State, CBSE and ICSE boards — from foundation subjects right through to full board-exam preparation.

faqs.q: Do you offer one-to-one and individual tuition?
faqs.a: Yes. Individual, one-to-one focus is what we do — plus small batches — so every student is genuinely seen, heard and helped.

faqs.q: Do you offer online tuition as well as offline?
faqs.a: Yes — every programme is available both offline at our Ashokapuram centre and live online, with the same one-to-one attention either way.

faqs.q: Do you run SAY / Improvement exam classes for Plus One and Plus Two?
faqs.a: Yes. We run dedicated SAY (Save A Year) and Improvement exam batches for Plus One and Plus Two, plus exam assistance — focused revision, previous-year papers, answer-writing and daily doubt-clearing timed to your exam.
Fees are simple, per-hour rates by class — from ₹150/hour for Class I–IV up to ₹350/hour for Plus One / Plus Two, with a one-time ₹500 admission fee. See the full fee structure for details.
Pootholi Building, behind Rajendra Hospital, Ashokapuram, Kozhikode 673001. Plus code 7Q8J+F3.
Monday to Friday 2 PM – 7 PM, and Saturday & Sunday 7 AM – 6:30 PM — open all 7 days, with live online classes available across Kerala.

faqs.q: Is there a free demo class?
faqs.a: Yes — your first demo class is free and there's no obligation to continue. It's the best way to see if we're the right fit.
Through regular tests, doubt sessions and direct parent updates, so you always know how your child is doing.
